title: Shield nerfs, Meowdame's Trial rewards, and a Ruins Challenge tweak
summary: This version nerfs Platyputz's Bubble Shield star-up bonus and several "add shield" buff effects, adds a new epic treasure-chest item and matching art for Meowdame's Trial, and removes the difficulty-scaling penalty in the Ruins Challenge power-inhibit formula.
highlights: Nerfed Platyputz's Bubble Shield star-up bonus (about 5 percentage points lower at every tier and level) and cut several "add shield" buff effects' shield amounts roughly in half at higher levels.
Added Meowdame's Gift (Basic), a new epic treasure chest reward from Meowdame's Trial, plus matching profile-frame UI art.
Simplified the Ruins Challenge power-inhibit formula to always return 0 (removing its difficulty-scaling penalty) and widened its threshold range.
Widened the ranking power range from [100,200] to [100,800].
Added new buff definitions for Desert Tolerance and Armigo camp-defense mechanics.
Added new city race and Cross-Server Arena UI art.
